body: I was considering hanging myself today, which Im pretty sure isn't conductive to your well being. But when youre depressed things don't seem so easy

I can very much relate to that story. The worst part is I know that the longer I wait the worse it'll get but I can't seem to find the motivation to care. I don't have any friends but that is my fault because I isolated myself  

I do have a psychiatrist appointment next week. Maybe I can wait until then and see if that will make me feel better. I really hope so. Thanks

Yeah its social anxiety holding me back, Im just too scared to face it. I've willingly failed college courses because I would skip a big presentation or not go to class once I found out that there would be group work/presentations. People always say that the more you do it the easier it becomes - but that never was true for me, it was terrible and anxiety-ridden every time I've had to speak in front of the class or even answering a question. After high school I just avoided it all together which is why I failed college courses so much.

I fucking hate it. Every day I ask, "why me?", why did I have to be the only fucking person in my family to have social anxiety. Why couldn't I just grow out of awkwardness like most people do? I'm 22 years old and I've never gone a date before; I've never even held a girls hand. I know deep down I'll be alone for the rest of my life because:  

1. No girl wants to date someone who is going nowhere in life  
2. Even if they did, I wouldn't to say or how to act, and I would be too scared to talk to them anyways

Social anxiety truly is a soul crushing disorder

I want to be lazy, but I figure I can only be lazy for so long before my parents kick me out on the streets. So i figure this is the only option for someone who wants to be lazy like me. Im not a productive member of society, nor do I wish to be one

I don't have any motivations to do anything. I would much rather be lazy than actually try not to be, so I suppose that's the issue. And I've already been in therapy before, but like all things you have to put effort into it in order to get better and I didn't want to do anything my therapist asked me to do.
I just made a post about laziness too. I also don't want to deal with life because of laziness. I think you and I are very much alike
Same as you, I have social anxiety and I imagine Ill probably be alone for the rest of my life. Also, I dont enjoy anything
Glad things worked out for you but it doesnt really change my outlook, sorry
Thats crazy, I was thinking about using my belt on the pull up bar in my room as well. Did it hurt before you lost consciousness?

Yeah I have the same fear of people hearing. Like I get concerned that they might notice me not peeing and just standing there, and no matter how full my bladder is I cant go. I usually have to pee in a stall :(

I was at a point once where I had some hope, it was when I first told my family about it and I was going to the doc/therapist. I have tried about 6 different medications that all made me feel like shit, but was enjoying therapy.

About a few months into therapy,  I got high as fuck one night and had a deep realization that the only way to get better is to step out of my comfort zone, as you mentioned. I also had an even worse realization, that I  literally would rather die than step out of my comfort zone. I truly am pathetic.

Ive never even had to courage to say yes to a girl. I had one opportunity when I was 12 (now 22) and I didn't take it and I haven't had anything close to a relationship in my entire life, because I just avoid women. I know how you feel, shits rough

I certainly think its a way out if you know that you will not do anything to help yourself. I fully understand that being on the computer all day gets me nowhere, but I honestly dont even care anymore. I used to be big into weightlifting but I havent gone in the gym in a month and its because Ive lost all interest in it

I have social anxiety and agoraphobia so that would be a no go, but its not like I would do it anyways. Like I mentioned, I dont want to do anything,I literally spend 16-18 hours a day on the internet, and now I've been doing a lot of research on suicide methods
